Hi Elena — appreciate the questions and the uploaded questionnaire. I asked Dev and Rishi to chime in; answers below are intended to be high-level so you can validate risk quickly — we’ll populate the spreadsheet with firm answers this week.

Telemetry / PII:
- By default, telemetry events do NOT include customer-managed PII fields (we strip email addresses and full text payloads).
- We collect event-level metadata (event name, timestamp, anonymized user hash, request latency, error codes) primarily for reliability and performance tuning.
- For customers that opt into deeper debugging, we can capture payload snippets but only with explicit customer consent and a data retention window.

Docs / cookies:
- Public docs: third-party analytics (Google Analytics) + first-party session cookie for preferences (language, theme). No account-identifying cookie is set on the public docs site.
- Console: session cookies are issued for logged-in users; these are first-party and tied to authentication. We offer an option to disable analytics cookies and to limit telemetry collection for enterprise accounts.

Audit logs & retention:
- Audit logs (admin actions, API keys, auth events) are available in the Console and can be exported to customer-managed S3 or GCS buckets.
- Default retention is 90 days; we offer extended retention (1, 3, 7 years) as an add-on or configurable for Dedicated/Private customers.

SOC 2 report: we completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025. We can provide the full report under NDA within 2 business days once we have an executed NDA/SDR.

GDPR/HIPAA:
- We offer a DPA (link below) and will sign a BAA for covered customers. We also support EU region hosting for data residency requirements.

Links & attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf attached; privacy docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/privacy.

Next steps:
- We’ll start filling the questionnaire (Dev will handle technical sections, I’ll coordinate procurement/legal items). Target to return a completed version by Tue, 7 Apr.
- Propose a 30-min technical follow-up with Dev the week of Apr 6 to walk telemetry examples and any requested redaction controls. Please send availability.

Best,
Marissa
